interview.name: Cleo
interview.answer: The notes do not say when or where the repair drive is being held.

reflections: Rey is proactively supportive and offers concrete help rather than vague reassurance.
Cleo is organized and dependable, taking responsibility for tracking shared needs.
The group relies on clear task handoff and appreciation to coordinate effectively.
Cleo is becoming the central organizer for the repair drive, tracking supplies and keeping the list current.
Rey and Mara are contributing concrete materials, while Dane relies on Cleo’s coordination because he expects to arrive late.
The group communicates in a cooperative, practical way, with people offering specific help and thanking Cleo for follow-through.
Cleo is the main coordinator for the repair drive and is repeatedly asked for the latest supplies list.
Several people are willing to contribute items or help spread the word, but they want timely updates on what is still needed.
The repair drive is a shared, time-specific community effort, and people are coordinating around practical constraints like pickup schedules and drop-off timing.
Cleo is the central coordinator for the repair drive and is trusted to track supplies and share updates.
Mina, Quinn, Faye, and Noah are responsive helpers who want to relay information or coordinate around the event.
The group communicates efficiently by routing status updates through Cleo to keep everyone aligned on shortages, timing, and logistics.
Cleo is the central organizer who keeps the repair drive logistics moving and repeatedly follows up on supplies and missing details.
Noah and Eli are responsive support contacts: they acknowledge gaps, share updates when available, and help keep information flowing.

events.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need most right now?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — we’re short on screws, duct tape, and a couple of strong flashlights. If you can bring any of that, it’ll help a lot.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Rey: I can bring screws and duct tape today, and I’ll look for a couple of strong flashlights too.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies list and see what we still need for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — that’d be a big help. I usually end up arriving late, so I appreciate you keeping tabs on it.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Cleo: No problem — I’ll keep the list updated and let you know if anything’s running low.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Cleo: I’ve still got the supplies list open, and I’ll let you know if anything’s running low for the repair drive.

events.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll keep watching the list and let you know right away if anything’s getting low.

events.text: Cleo: I’ve still got the supplies list open, and I’ll let you know if anything’s running low for the repair drive.
